evals.prompt: /skill:nbr-dispatch The link handling is wrong here. Start a Pi worker to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the current Git root, asks the user to confirm its absolute path before inspecting the worktree or creating a pane, then launches the worker in the confirmed repository's Rex session.
